# Support

Start with the [Windows guide](../windows/README.md) and [docs index](../docs/README.md).

For bugs, [open an issue](https://github.com/Jiocode1/mimo/issues) with the Mimo
version, Windows version, display scaling and steps to reproduce. Include useful
logs or screenshots after removing personal data.

For a feature, describe the problem and the workflow it would improve.
For a fix, [open a pull request](CONTRIBUTING.md).
Use [security reporting](SECURITY.md) for sensitive issues.

The Windows installer is unsigned. Verify its checksum or build from source
using the [distribution guide](../docs/distribution.md).
